headline: Case filed after blast at NCP rally in Savar leaves several injured
summary: A case has been filed against unidentified suspects after a crude bomb explosion at a National Citizen Party event, which party leaders claim was a planned attempt to kill them.
details: A case has been filed under the Explosives Substances Act following a blast at a National Citizen Party (NCP) rally at Tarapur Eidgah Ground in Savar, on the outskirts of Dhaka.
The explosion occurred around 9:42 pm while NCP leaders, including Convener Md Nahid Islam and Member Secretary Akhtar Hossain MP, were delivering speeches on stage.

The blast took place 10 to 15 feet in front of the stage, sending white smoke across the venue and causing widespread panic among attendees, including journalists and families of July uprising victims.
Several people were seriously injured in the blast, including Md Shahin Khandaker, Md Jasim, Md Shahadat Hossain, and journalists from DBC News and NPB News.
The FIR notes that electricity to the venue was disconnected shortly before leaders took the stage, leaving the site largely in darkness despite the use of generators.
Party leaders allege the blast was a planned attack intended to kill NCP leadership and members of the public, with suspicions of involvement by a banned outfit.
Savar Model Police Station has confirmed the case and stated that operations are currently underway to arrest those responsible for the explosion.
caption:
A planned blast at an NCP rally in Savar left several injured and sparked chaos. Party leaders claim it was an attempt on their lives.

The explosion occurred around 9:42 pm while NCP leaders, including Convener Md Nahid Islam and Member Secretary Akhtar Hossain MP, were delivering speeches on stage.

The blast took place 10 to 15 feet in front of the stage, sending white smoke across the venue and causing widespread panic among attendees, including journalists and families of July uprising victims.

Several people were seriously injured in the blast, including Md Shahin Khandaker, Md Jasim, Md Shahadat Hossain, and journalists from DBC News and NPB News.

The FIR notes that electricity to the venue was disconnected shortly before leaders took the stage, leaving the site largely in darkness despite the use of generators.

Party leaders allege the blast was a planned attack intended to kill NCP leadership and members of the public, with suspicions of involvement by a banned outfit.

Savar Model Police Station has confirmed the case and stated that operations are currently underway to arrest those responsible for the explosion.

headline_marked: PM Tarique Rahman [[makes surprise visit to army training ground]] in Manikganj
headline: PM Tarique Rahman makes surprise visit to army training ground in Manikganj
summary: The Prime Minister observed military drills, interacted with soldiers, and shared a meal with troops during a first-of-its-kind visit to a summer exercise area.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman conducted a surprise visit to the Bangladesh Army's summer exercise in Singair upazila of Manikganj this morning. He arrived at the training area of 8 Bir under the 9 Infantry Division at around 9:20 am.
The Prime Minister inspected various parts of the 'firm base' and received briefings from the general officer commanding of the division and the unit's commanding officer on tactical preparations.

During the visit, he witnessed a raid exercise and observed battlefield positioning, tactical manoeuvres, and the use of weapons. He also entered an army bunker to discuss operational tactics with officers and soldiers.
In a historic first, the Prime Minister spent an extended period in the field, sharing freshly cooked food and tea with the participating soldiers.
Addressing the troops, Tarique Rahman stated that the people of Bangladesh have deep trust in the army, praising their role in national crises and maintaining law and order.
He emphasized the importance of professional training, discipline, and maintaining the highest level of operational preparedness for the force.
The visit was attended by Defence Adviser Brig Gen (retd) AKM Shamsul Islam, Chief of Army Staff Gen Waker-Uz-Zaman, and other senior army officials.
